content.title: Investor Factors in the Chinese A-Share Market: Evidence from a Principal Component Analysis of Institutional Holdings
content.abstract: This paper investigates investor factors in the Chinese A-share market from July 2003 to December 2025. Using principal component analysis on 10 candidate factors, we find that the first three components explain 78.9% of the total variance (PC1: 39.8%, PC2: 22.8%, PC3: 16.3%). The constructed investor factor (SophMinusOther) yields a mean monthly return of 0.03% (t = 0.14), and an FF5 + UMD alpha of 0.20% (t = 1.03).
